<?php
/** Theme-owned contact and quotation processing; WooCommerce owns product data. */
if (!defined('ABSPATH')) exit;
require_once __DIR__ . '/email.php';

function tps_pack_receipt_key($receipt) {
 return 'tps_receipt_' . hash_hmac('sha256', $receipt, wp_salt('nonce'));
}

/** The URL token contains no personal details; it can be used only once. */
function tps_pack_guard_thank_you_page() {
 if (!is_page(array('bedankt-contact', 'bedankt-aanvraag'))) return;
 if (is_preview() && current_user_can('edit_pages')) return;
 $kind = is_page('bedankt-contact') ? 'contact' : 'aanvraag';
 $receipt = isset($_GET['receipt']) && is_string($_GET['receipt']) ? wp_unslash($_GET['receipt']) : '';
 $valid = preg_match('/\A[a-f0-9]{40}\z/D', $receipt);
 $key = $valid ? tps_pack_receipt_key($receipt) : '';
 $stored = $valid ? get_transient($key) : false;
 $stored_kind = is_array($stored) ? ($stored['kind'] ?? '') : $stored;
 if ($stored_kind !== $kind) {
  wp_safe_redirect(function_exists('tps_pack_url') ? tps_pack_url($kind === 'contact' ? 'contact' : 'aanvraag') : home_url($kind === 'contact' ? '/contact/' : '/aanvraag/'), 303);
  exit;
 }
 $GLOBALS['tps_pack_customer_mail_accepted'] = is_array($stored) ? !empty($stored['customer_mail_accepted']) : null;
 delete_transient($key);
 if (!defined('DONOTCACHEPAGE')) define('DONOTCACHEPAGE', true);
 nocache_headers();
}
add_action('template_redirect', 'tps_pack_guard_thank_you_page', 1);

/** Rate keys contain hashed, site-secret values; never store raw IP/email. */
function tps_pack_limit_key($bucket, $value) {
 return 'tps_rl_' . hash_hmac('sha256', $bucket . '|' . $value, wp_salt('auth'));
}

function tps_pack_check_rate_limits($email) {
 $keys = array(array(tps_pack_limit_key('email', strtolower($email)), 3));
 $ip = isset($_SERVER['REMOTE_ADDR']) && is_string($_SERVER['REMOTE_ADDR']) ? trim($_SERVER['REMOTE_ADDR']) : '';
 if ($ip !== '' && filter_var($ip, FILTER_VALIDATE_IP)) {
  $keys[] = array(tps_pack_limit_key('ip', $ip), 12);
 }
 foreach ($keys as $entry) {
  if ((int) get_transient($entry[0]) >= $entry[1]) return false;
 }
 foreach ($keys as $entry) {
  $hits = (int) get_transient($entry[0]);
  set_transient($entry[0], $hits + 1, 15 * MINUTE_IN_SECONDS);
 }
 return true;
}

function tps_pack_character_count($value) {
 if (function_exists('mb_strlen')) return mb_strlen($value, 'UTF-8');
 $count = preg_match_all('/./us', $value, $matches);
 return $count === false ? strlen($value) : $count;
}

function tps_pack_post_string($name, $max = 0, $multiline = false) {
 if (!isset($_POST[$name]) || !is_string($_POST[$name])) return '';
 $raw = wp_unslash($_POST[$name]);
 $text = $multiline ? sanitize_textarea_field($raw) : sanitize_text_field($raw);
 if ($max && tps_pack_character_count($text) > $max) return false;
 return $text;
}

function tps_pack_handle_enquiry() {
 if (($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] ?? '') !== 'POST') {
  wp_die(esc_html__('Invalid request.', 'tps-pack'), '', array('response' => 405));
 }
 $kind = tps_pack_post_string('tps_kind', 12);
 if (!in_array($kind, array('contact', 'aanvraag'), true)) {
  wp_die(esc_html__('Invalid request.', 'tps-pack'), '', array('response' => 400));
 }
 $fallback = $kind === 'contact' ? '/contact/' : '/aanvraag/';
 $base_url = function_exists('tps_pack_url') ? tps_pack_url(trim($fallback, '/')) : home_url($fallback);
 $failure_url = add_query_arg('status', 'error', $base_url);
 $nonce = tps_pack_post_string('tps_nonce', 100);
 if (!is_string($nonce) || !wp_verify_nonce($nonce, 'tps_pack_form_' . $kind) || (isset($_POST['tps_company_site']) && !is_string($_POST['tps_company_site'])) || tps_pack_post_string('tps_company_site', 150) !== '') {
  wp_safe_redirect($failure_url, 303); exit;
 }
 $name = tps_pack_post_string('tps_name', 180);
 $email_raw = tps_pack_post_string('tps_email', 254);
 $email = is_string($email_raw) ? sanitize_email($email_raw) : '';
 $message = tps_pack_post_string('tps_message', 6000, true);
 $company = tps_pack_post_string('tps_company', 150);
 $phone = tps_pack_post_string('tps_phone', 60);
 $manual_product = tps_pack_post_string('tps_material', 180);
 $quantity = tps_pack_post_string('tps_quantity', 160);
 $specs = tps_pack_post_string('tps_specs', 1200, true);
 $values = array($name,$message,$company,$phone,$manual_product,$quantity,$specs);
 if (in_array(false, $values, true) || !is_email($email) || !is_string($name) || trim($name) === '' || !is_string($message) || tps_pack_character_count($message) < 10) {
  wp_safe_redirect($failure_url, 303); exit;
 }
 // The quote-only fields cannot silently be submitted via the contact flow.
 if ($kind === 'contact') {
  $manual_product = ''; $quantity = ''; $specs = '';
 }
 $product_name = '';
 $product_obj = false;
 if ($kind === 'aanvraag' && isset($_POST['tps_product_id']) && is_string($_POST['tps_product_id']) && function_exists('wc_get_product')) {
  $submitted_id = wp_unslash($_POST['tps_product_id']);
  $product_obj = ctype_digit($submitted_id) && (int) $submitted_id > 0 ? wc_get_product(absint($submitted_id)) : false;
  if ($product_obj && $product_obj->get_status() === 'publish' && $product_obj->is_visible()) {
   $product_name = sanitize_text_field($product_obj->get_name());
  } else {
   $product_obj = false;
  }
 }
 $product = $product_name !== '' ? $product_name : $manual_product;
 $fields = array(
  'name'=>$name,'email'=>$email,'company'=>$company,'phone'=>$phone,
  'product'=>$product,'quantity'=>$quantity,'specs'=>$specs,'message'=>$message
 );
 $recipient = apply_filters('tps_pack_inquiry_recipient', get_option('admin_email'));
 if (!is_string($recipient) || !is_email($recipient)) { wp_safe_redirect($failure_url, 303); exit; }
 // Suppress rapid duplicate submissions while preserving a separate rate limit.
 $fingerprint = tps_pack_limit_key('duplicate', $kind . '|' . $email . '|' . $message . '|' . $product . '|' . $quantity . '|' . $specs);
 if (get_transient($fingerprint)) {
  wp_safe_redirect(add_query_arg('status', 'duplicate', $base_url), 303); exit;
 }
 if (!tps_pack_check_rate_limits($email)) {
  wp_safe_redirect(add_query_arg('status', 'limited', $base_url), 303); exit;
 }
 if (!set_transient($fingerprint, 1, 10 * MINUTE_IN_SECONDS)) {
  wp_safe_redirect($failure_url, 303); exit;
 }
 try {
  $receipt = bin2hex(random_bytes(20));
 } catch (Throwable $exception) {
  delete_transient($fingerprint);
  wp_safe_redirect($failure_url, 303); exit;
 }
 $receipt_key = tps_pack_receipt_key($receipt);
 if (!set_transient($receipt_key, array('kind'=>$kind, 'customer_mail_accepted'=>false), 10 * MINUTE_IN_SECONDS)) {
  delete_transient($fingerprint);
  wp_safe_redirect($failure_url, 303); exit;
 }
 $admin_subject = $kind === 'contact' ? 'TPS Pack | New contact message' : 'TPS Pack | New quotation request';
 if ($product_obj && $product_name !== '') $fields['product_ref'] = (string) absint($product_obj->get_id());
 if ($product_obj && $product_name !== '' && method_exists($product_obj, 'get_sku') && $product_obj->get_sku() !== '') {
  $fields['specs'] = trim($fields['specs'] . "\nSKU: " . sanitize_text_field($product_obj->get_sku()));
 }
 $html_headers = array('Content-Type: text/html; charset=UTF-8');
 $admin_headers = array_merge($html_headers, array('Reply-To: ' . $email));
 $sent_to_owner = wp_mail($recipient, $admin_subject, tps_pack_email_html($kind, 'owner', $fields), $admin_headers);
 if (!$sent_to_owner) {
  delete_transient($receipt_key);
  delete_transient($fingerprint);
  wp_safe_redirect($failure_url, 303); exit;
 }
 $customer_subject = $kind === 'aanvraag' ? 'TPS Pack | Your quotation request' : 'TPS Pack | Confirmation of your message';
 // The customer reply goes to the site recipient, not to a no-reply sender.
 $customer_headers = array_merge($html_headers, array('Reply-To: ' . $recipient));
 $customer_sent = wp_mail($email, $customer_subject, tps_pack_email_html($kind, 'customer', $fields), $customer_headers);
 if (!$customer_sent) error_log('TPS Pack: customer form confirmation was not accepted by wp_mail.');
 set_transient($receipt_key, array('kind'=>$kind, 'customer_mail_accepted'=>(bool) $customer_sent), 10 * MINUTE_IN_SECONDS);
 $destination = $kind === 'contact' ? '/bedankt-contact/' : '/bedankt-aanvraag/';
 wp_safe_redirect(add_query_arg('receipt', $receipt, function_exists('tps_pack_url') ? tps_pack_url(trim($destination, '/')) : home_url($destination)), 303);
 exit;
}
add_action('admin_post_nopriv_tps_pack_enquiry', 'tps_pack_handle_enquiry');
add_action('admin_post_tps_pack_enquiry', 'tps_pack_handle_enquiry');

<?php
/** English editorial defaults, URL helpers and theme-only SEO fallback. */
if (!defined('ABSPATH')) exit;

function tps_pack_editor_defaults() {
 static $defaults = null;
 if ($defaults === null) {
  $filename = get_parent_theme_file_path('content/en.json');
  $decoded = is_readable($filename) ? json_decode((string) file_get_contents($filename), true) : array();
  $defaults = is_array($decoded) ? $decoded : array();
 }
 return $defaults;
}

function tps_pack_ui_defaults() {
 static $defaults = null;
 if ($defaults === null) {
  $filename = get_parent_theme_file_path('content/ui-defaults.json');
  $decoded = is_readable($filename) ? json_decode((string) file_get_contents($filename), true) : array();
  $defaults = is_array($decoded) ? $decoded : array();
 }
 return $defaults;
}

function tps_pack_url($slug = '') {
 $slug = trim((string) $slug, '/');
 if ($slug === '') return home_url('/');
 // Honour WordPress permalink filters used by translation and SEO plugins.
 $page = get_page_by_path($slug, OBJECT, 'page');
 return $page && $page->post_status === 'publish' ? get_permalink($page->ID) : home_url('/' . $slug . '/');
}

function tps_pack_info_page_slug() {
 if (is_front_page()) return 'home';
 if (!is_page()) return null;
 $slug = get_post_field('post_name', get_queried_object_id());
 return is_string($slug) ? $slug : null;
}

function tps_pack_field_name($slug, $path) {
 return 'tps_editor_' . substr(hash('sha256', $slug . '|' . implode('|', array_map('strval', $path))), 0, 22);
}
function tps_pack_field_key($slug, $path) {
 return 'field_' . tps_pack_field_name($slug, $path);
}

function tps_pack_editor_field_allowed($path, $value) {
 if (!is_string($value)) return false;
 foreach ($path as $segment) {
  if (in_array($segment, array('provenance','slug','external','form','receipt'), true)) return false;
 }
 return true;
}

/** Flatten content into stable scalar ACF fields, without requiring ACF Pro repeaters. */
function tps_pack_flatten_editor_fields($slug, $value, $path = array()) {
 $fields = array();
 if (is_array($value)) {
  foreach ($value as $key => $part) {
   $fields = array_merge($fields, tps_pack_flatten_editor_fields($slug, $part, array_merge($path, array($key))));
  }
 } elseif (tps_pack_editor_field_allowed($path, $value)) {
  $fields[] = array('path'=>$path, 'name'=>tps_pack_field_name($slug, $path), 'key'=>tps_pack_field_key($slug, $path), 'default'=>$value);
 }
 return $fields;
}

function tps_pack_editor_specs($slug) {
 // A page may have structured editorial sections as well as editable form/UI labels.
 // Merge both lists so introducing UI fields never hides the established ACF keys.
 $defaults = tps_pack_editor_defaults();
 $fields = isset($defaults[$slug]) ? tps_pack_flatten_editor_fields($slug, $defaults[$slug]) : array();
 $map = tps_pack_ui_defaults();
 $ui_fields = array();
 if (isset($map[$slug])) {
  foreach ($map[$slug] as $label) {
   $ui_fields[] = array('path'=>array('ui',$label), 'name'=>tps_pack_field_name($slug, array('ui',$label)),
    'key'=>tps_pack_field_key($slug, array('ui',$label)), 'default'=>$label);
  }
 }
 return array_merge($fields, $ui_fields);
}

function tps_pack_editor_value($slug, $path, $fallback, $post_id = 0) {
 if (!$post_id) $post_id = (int) get_queried_object_id();
 // With Settings > Reading set to "Your latest posts", the homepage query has no page ID.
 // Resolve its editor fields from the safely provisioned Home page instead.
 if (!$post_id && $slug === 'home' && is_front_page()) {
  $post_id = (int) tps_pack_editor_page_id('home');
 }
 if ($post_id > 0) {
  $saved = get_post_meta($post_id, tps_pack_field_name($slug, $path), true);
  if (is_string($saved) && $saved !== '') {
   // ACF fields used by this theme are plain-text or textarea fields.
   if (end($path) === 'image' && !in_array($saved, array('bedrijfsgebouw.jpg','tape-converting-workstation.webp'), true)) return $fallback;
   return $saved;
  }
 }
 return $fallback;
}

function tps_pack_overlay_copy($slug, $value, $path, $post_id) {
 if (is_array($value)) {
  foreach ($value as $key => $part) {
   $value[$key] = tps_pack_overlay_copy($slug, $part, array_merge($path, array($key)), $post_id);
  }
  return $value;
 }
 return tps_pack_editor_field_allowed($path, $value)
  ? tps_pack_editor_value($slug, $path, $value, $post_id) : $value;
}

function tps_pack_info_copy($slug) {
 $defaults = tps_pack_editor_defaults();
 if (!isset($defaults[$slug])) return null;
 return tps_pack_overlay_copy($slug, $defaults[$slug], array(), get_queried_object_id());
}

/** English copy is canonical; saved page ACF values override only on their page. */
function tps_pack_text($english) {
 $slug = tps_pack_info_page_slug();
 if (array_key_exists($slug, tps_pack_ui_defaults())) {
  $map = tps_pack_ui_defaults();
  if (in_array($english, $map[$slug] ?? array(), true)) {
   return tps_pack_editor_value($slug, array('ui',$english), $english);
  }
 }
 return $english;
}

/** The translation plugin, not this theme, owns localized URLs, hreflang and language selection. */
function tps_pack_owns_info_seo() {
 return !defined('WPSEO_VERSION') && !defined('RANK_MATH_VERSION') && !defined('AIOSEO_VERSION');
}
add_filter('pre_get_document_title', function ($title) {
 if (!tps_pack_owns_info_seo()) return $title;
 $slug = tps_pack_info_page_slug();
 if ($slug === 'home') return 'Adhesive tapes and packaging materials | Tape Solutions';
 $copy = $slug !== null ? tps_pack_info_copy($slug) : null;
 return is_array($copy) && !empty($copy['title']) ? $copy['title'] . ' | Tape Solutions' : $title;
});
add_action('wp_head', function () {
 if (!tps_pack_owns_info_seo()) return;
 $slug = tps_pack_info_page_slug();
 if ($slug === null) return;
 $copy = $slug !== 'home' ? tps_pack_info_copy($slug) : null;
 $description = is_array($copy) && !empty($copy['lead']) ? $copy['lead'] : 'Explore adhesive tapes, packaging materials and custom solutions from Tape Solutions.';
 echo '<meta name="description" content="' . esc_attr($description) . '">' . "\n";
});
add_filter('wp_robots', function ($robots) {
 if (is_page(array('bedankt-contact','bedankt-aanvraag'))) $robots['noindex'] = true;
 return $robots;
});

/** Keep existing Gutenberg content visible below the editorial ACF layout on legacy pages. */
function tps_pack_output_editor_extra_content() {
 $content = get_post_field('post_content', get_queried_object_id());
 if (!is_string($content) || trim($content) === '') return;
 echo '<section class="section wrap tps-editor-extras" aria-label="Additional page information">';
 while (have_posts()) { the_post(); the_content(); }
 echo '</section>';
}
